A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] worked as an '''intake officer''' aboard [[Macula Station]] above the [[Prison/Legends|prison]]-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. There he worked with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[05-D6]], and greeted arrivals to the station who planned on traveling down to Belsavis, confiscating their equipment before they did so. During the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], he greeted one individuals who had recently gained clearance to land and informed them that he wouldn't be confiscating their equipment as Belsavis's [[Warden/Legends|warden]] [[Playt]] wanted them down on the surface immediately.
